'''Davrill''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Big" />

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Davrill discovered that the old Balmorran government was sending generators to the [[Balmorran resistance]] in order to power the artillery. He tasked an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to locate the warehouse where these generators were being stored and destroy them.<ref name="Big" />
